stem:
Students in Mrs. Guerro's class must complete at least 40 math problems for homework every week. The table shows the progress of four students on Wednesday.

Homework Progress

| Student | Amount Completed |
|---------|-----------------|
| Katie   | 0.4             |
| D'Angelo| 45/40           |
| Grace   | 100%            |
| Jonah   | 2/3             |

Which list shows the amounts of homework completed in order from greatest to least?
visual_elements: Table with four rows: Katie - 0.4, D'Angelo - 45/40, Grace - 100%, Jonah - 2/3
